name: Day of a Doll
source:
"Day of a Doll" follows a Doll's entire day.

You guide her choices, so don't lead her astray.

The story uses poems instead of paragraphs,

Plus digital collages mixed with real paper crafts!

[From [url=https://ghostible.itch.io/day-of-a-doll]itch.io[/url]]
